output.summary: The evidence points to the per-agent quota as the main driver. First-contact demand is up only 4% (8,770 to 9,120). Ticket creation grew from 9,420 to 15,600 because of agent-created split tickets (240 to 3,710) and customer duplicates (410 to 2,770). Reopens rose from 6% to 23%. The reopen trigger and report definition were unchanged, so this is not a measurement artifact. Quick-win picking went from 0 to 41% of picks, and complex tickets aged over 7 days tripled. Headcount and scheduled hours are flat, and Payroll volume is small. Engineering bugs rose from 40 to 71, but the link to aged tickets is unverified. Suspend the quota, measure quality, and classify the aged tickets. Do not tighten the target or add headcount yet.
